section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1974
title: 24 Volume of Suicides in States, Union Territories and Cities The volume of suicides per one lakh of population for India was 7.85, for States it was also 7.85 and for the Union Territories it was 7.58. Among State the volume of suicides per one lakh of population ranged between 25.59 to 0.04. The maximum was for Tripura (25.59) and the minimum for Jammu & Kashmir (0.04), Among Union Territories, the volume of suicides was 69.11 for A & N Islands followed by Pondicherry (51.49). For other Union Territories, the volume of suicides per one lakh of population ranged between 7.59 to 0.55. There was no case of suicide in Lakshadweep.
